eventMetadata.context_description: The Minnesota Vikings host the Green Bay Packers on September 13 in their 2026 regular-season opener at U.S. Bank Stadium, with Kyler Murray set to start at quarterback after edging out J.J. McCarthy amid the latter’s ankle issues and inconsistent preseason play. Murray’s downfield ability and veteran experience give Minnesota a clearer offensive identity heading into a competitive NFC North matchup. Both clubs enter with recent 9-win seasons and strong divisional history, though the Packers closed preseason with a high-scoring win over Arizona while addressing key injuries such as tight end Tucker Kraft’s knee. Roster cuts and final preparations this week will shape depth, particularly along the lines and at skill positions, as each side seeks early momentum in a division where home-field splits and turnover margins often decide close contests.
